comments.body:
This is at the end of a three-quest chain:
Battles on a Steam Ship -- London/Lisbon Maritime Mediator
Pig Delivery Request -- London/Lisbon/Seville Merchant Mediator
Steam Ship Investigation Report -- London, Lisbon Adventure Mediator

You must be and stay on a steam ship for it to appear and for the whole quest
But you can be towed in fleet, no problem

wiki:
How to obtain:

This title requires completion of the following quests:

Battles on a Steam Ship (Battle)
Pig Delivery Request (Trade)
Steam Ship Investigation Report (Adventure)


Notes:

1. The quests will not appear unless you are in a steamship-type vessel.
2. It is possible to complete the quests by being towed in fleet.
3. You cannot swap ships with an aide, or change ships in a port after accepting a quest; this will automatically discard the quest.
4. This title's effect is cumulative with a nation's IR boom status.
